task.title: Prevent dev deployment from pruning canonical telemetry

scope.owned_layer: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh prune_dev_management_ai_telemetry_for_disk() and configure_management_ai_dev_env() truncate scope and validation
not_changing: The dev-root/postgres-backend/PANTHEON_DEV_POSTGRES_TELEMETRY_PRUNE gating that decides whether the prune runs at all
The diagnostic before/after size listing across all schemas
Any production or non-dev deployment path

defect.summary: The truncation loop matched n.nspname IN (target_schema, 'public'), so every dev root deploy truncated public.telemetry_events (the canonical table) in addition to the derived Management AI schema's copy.
defect.impact: Canonical telemetry_events data in the public schema was silently emptied on every dev root deploy that ran the disk-pruning step, even though the prune was only meant to bound the derived Management AI store.

fix.summary: Scoped the TRUNCATE loop strictly to n.nspname = target_schema (MANAGEMENT_AI_STORE_SCHEMA, default management_ai); added fail-closed preflight and DO-block validation rejecting empty, non-identifier, or 'public' schemas with hard errors; and added pre/post canonical public telemetry preservation sentinels comparing row count, min created_at, and deterministic checksum to fail closed on any canonical drift.

dry_runs.summary: Verified preflight parameters, schema validation, and plan without SSH mutation.
Consecutive dry-run produced identical plan output.

results.focused_pytest_suite: 18 passed (11 prune tests including 5 live PostgreSQL behavioral tests + 7 bootstrap contract tests)

required_focus: Confirm the truncate predicate strictly matches n.nspname = target_schema and never 'public'
Confirm empty, invalid identifier, and 'public' target_schema fail closed before SQL mutation
Confirm canonical public.telemetry_events pre/post state is strictly asserted and fails on drift
Confirm behavioral tests cover positive prune, missing table no-op, public schema rejection, invalid identifier rejection, and drift detection
